title: Halo button
description: 4px-cornered buttons in four looks: hot orange primary, solid foreground fill (white on black panels), a quiet translucent square, and a thin outlined one. Regular weight, no shadow, colour change on hover.
notes: light and quiet are meant for black panels: wrap them in a .dark area
name: halodental-sonnet-button

props.name: href
props.description: renders a link when set, a button otherwise

props.name: variant
props.description:
primary: orange fill · light: foreground-coloured fill, for dark panels · quiet: a faint
translucent square (language switch, icon buttons) · outline: thin hairline, no fill

props.name: size
props.description: sm: 32px tall · md: 40px tall · lg: 44px tall (the play button)

props.name: type
props.description: the button's type when it isn't a link

props.name: disabled
props.description: greys it out and blocks clicks (a form button before the form is filled in)

props.name: label
props.description: screen-reader name, for buttons that hold only an icon
